completed_units: Reduced LIFT exactly to the third-digit observer E_p=(W_p-p)/p^2 modulo p, equivalently W_p congruent p modulo p^3, after consuming the accepted UR/JT0 parent result.

Proved the p-adic shell decomposition of the weighted 3F2 ports, deleted I3 only by pointwise p^3 invisibility, and transported I2/p^2 to a fixed-parameter truncated 5F4 K_m with explicit residue-class sign (6/p).
For I1, with b_r=t_{2m+r}/p modulo p^2, proved the exact first-order p-shift law b_{r+1} congruent b_r R_r^(0)(1+pD_r) modulo p^2, where R_r^(0) and D_r are explicit rational functions of r.

Compressed the full I1 shell losslessly at the LIFT observer to one seed b_1 plus a fixed-parameter 5F4-type carrier q_s and its required first-order derivative/harmonic port H_s: S_1/p congruent b_1(Q_m+pJ_m) modulo p^2.
Proved the seed reduction b_1 congruent -10(2n)!/(n!^5 216^n) modulo p for n=(p+2)/3, while preserving the mod-p^2 correction of b_1 as a live scalar port.

Executed the exact I1 checker over all 166 target primes p<5000 (83 in each class); every transition, summed transport and seed check passed. Executed checker SHA-256 a56a3c4e0ba426b0093d91568571cb82ad2cec09a8d469e5bb41c818bb5ef227.
